title: Alike
summary: ALI'KE, adjective Having resemblance or similitude; similar. The darkness and the light are both alike to thee. Psalms 13:1. [This adjective never precedes the noun which it qualifies.] ALI'KE, adverb

inlines.v: ALI'KE, adjective Having resemblance or similitude; similar. The darkness and the light are both alike to thee. Psalms 13:1. [This adjective never precedes the noun which it qualifies.] ALI'KE, adverb in the same manner, form or degree. We are all alike concerned in religion. He fashioneth their hearts alike Psalms 33:15.
